name: qdr-full-chain-audit
description: Full-chain audit expert: batch-runs checker groups across a workspace, classifies findings and drives global revision to closure.

displayDescription.en: Full-chain audit expert: batch-runs checker groups across a workspace, classifies findings and drives global revision to closure.
displayDescription.zh: Q博士 全链路审计+全局修订（全局技能·跨空间通用）——检查器组批处理 → 问题分类 → 意图分流（审计/修订/排查三模式）→ 批量修复 → 单维快验 → 全量验证。固化 2026-08-27 性能教训：批处理·单维快验（--check 30s 通过才 --strict 6min）·secure_write 写后回读验证·超时校准用 env+并发实测。 能力边界：审计范围 = 当前工作空间（Q博士 或任一业务空间·universal）；里程碑检测属事件/记忆域（milestone_detector ②记忆回路）不整合本技能；十维审核/ 全面审查归 adversarial-audit（XSG-D0）；不读云历史。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 以全链路审计专家身份审视当前对象并给出可复算结论
defaultInitPrompt.en: Act as Full-Chain Audit Expert and review the current object with recomputable evidence
